title: In my LLM-powered game, players crafted over 30,000 new cards in the first week!
author: GangstaRob7

comments.author: GangstaRob7
comments.body:
I made a game that is a like Infinite Craft, but with battles! You have a limited pool of cards, so make sure your combinations are strategically used to beat the current enemy. Keep battling to get powerups as rewards and ascend the leaderboard. Let me know what you like about the idea and if you have any feedback

Game Link - [https://infinite-card.net/](https://infinite-card.net/)

Discord Community - [https://discord.gg/CBhzbXYuvm](https://discord.gg/CBhzbXYuvm)

comments.author: ArialBear
comments.body: that is so cool. nice concept

comments.author: inigid
comments.body: Looks great!  How much did that cost you in image gen?

replies.author: GangstaRob7
replies.body: So anytime a player makes a new card, it queries the AI, meaning the cost is ongoing. But, so far the 30,000 cards has costed me around 100 dollars. Coincidentally, I have also made 100 dollars from people buying the game so I'm not in the hole lol

replies.author: inigid
replies.body:
Oh that's not too bad at all!  Much better than I thought.  What are you using?

That's really cool - nice.

replies.author: GangstaRob7
replies.body: Flux-schnell - oh yeah would be wayyy to expensive if I was using the best models everyone uses to make AI art. Smaller and cheaper and faster was my goal

replies.author: inigid
replies.body: Works for me!! Thanks a lot for the tips!   Keep building!!

replies.author: Amoner
replies.body: You could charge people to re-generate the art for the card if they have discovered it and want to use premium points \*, you only get those if you pay? and for those you could use a better model.
